record.title: Moguća uloga antioksidansa Glutationperoksidaze u patogenezi babezioze u pasa invadiranih protozoonom Babesia canis canis
record.journal: Zbornik radova Elektrotehnicki institut Nikola Tesla

screening.rationale: Title and OpenAlex metadata only; the CROSBI/CroRIS landing page is behind a bot check. It is a Mrljak-group study of glutathione peroxidase in the pathogenesis of B. canis canis infection, which would be eligible oxidative-stress evidence, but the 'Zbornik radova' source (first page 389) suggests conference proceedings, so peer-review status must be checked at full text.
